info.title: RustServer Versions API
info.description: Retrieves Rust Dedicated Server and Oxide version information.

get.summary: Gets the availability of the Versions API.
Gets the installed, running, and available Oxide versions.
Gets the installed, running, and available Rust versions.

installedVersion.description: Oxide version installed on disk, or null when Oxide is not installed.

runningVersion.description: Oxide version reported by the running server, or null when it is stopped.

availableVersion.description: Latest Oxide version available from GitHub.

updateAvailable.description: Whether Oxide needs installation or the available version differs from the installed version.

buildDate.description: UTC timestamp embedded in the running server build.

unityVersion.description: Unity version used to build the server.

branch.description: Rust branch reported by the server.

RustRunningVersion.description: Version metadata reported by the currently running Rust Dedicated Server. This metadata is distinct from Steam BuildIDs.

branch.description: Steam branch used by the server installation.

installedBuildId.description: Steam BuildID installed on disk, or null when Rust is not installed.

running.description: Version metadata reported by the running server, or null when it is stopped.

availableBuildId.description: Latest Steam BuildID available for the configured branch.

updateAvailable.description: Whether Rust needs installation or the available BuildID differs from the installed BuildID.

RustVersionInfo.description: Version state for Rust Dedicated Server.
